label: Circular Radar
description: Round grid with coloured rings, bracketed axis names and two filled series.
howTo: Bind `series[0].data[n].value` to one list of numbers per polygon, in the order of `radar.indicator`.
Each indicator needs a `max`; set `min` as well if the scale does not start at 0.
The brackets around the axis names come from `radar.axisName.formatter`; the ring colours from `radar.splitArea.areaStyle.color` (one per ring, outside in).
The ring colours are fixed, so this look is the same on light and dark themes.

label: Radar with Boxed Names
description: Polygon grid with boxed axis names, a dashed outline with value labels and a gradient-filled series.
howTo: Bind `series[0].data[0].value` (dashed outline) and `data[1].value` (filled) to lists in the order of `radar.indicator`.
Indicators may have different `max` values, so each spoke has its own scale.
The boxes are `radar.axisName` (`backgroundColor`, `borderRadius`, `padding`). The fill is a radial gradient object in `data[1].areaStyle.color`.

label: Dark Multi-run Radar
description: Many thin overlapping runs per series on a dark panel with a gold round grid (dark background is part of the look).
howTo: Every series holds MANY polygons: `series[n].data` is a list of rows, one row of indicator values per run (for example one per hour or per batch). Bind it to a dataset-to-rows transform.

The dark `backgroundColor` and the light text colours are part of the look, so it stays dark on a light theme. Remove `backgroundColor` and the `textStyle` / `axisName` colours to follow the theme instead.
Add `"selectedMode": "single"` to the legend to show one series at a time.

label: Filled Comparison Radar
description: Two translucent filled polygons for a plan-versus-actual comparison, with a legend and tooltip.
howTo: Bind `series[0].data[0].value` and `data[1].value` to lists in the order of `radar.indicator` (for example target and actual).
Set each indicator’s `max`; here all are 100 %.
